allow: PowerShell(git branch -r; foreach \($b in "origin/main","origin/dev","origin/develop"\) { if \(git rev-parse --verify --quiet $b\) { "{0}: HEAD ahead {1}, behind {2}" -f $b, \(git rev-list --count "$b..HEAD"\), \(git rev-list --count "HEAD..$b"\) } }; "--- files changed vs origin/dev:"; git diff --stat origin/dev...HEAD 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 1; "--- recent PR merges into main:"; git log origin/main --merges --oneline -5; Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Test-Path "C:\\Program Files\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe")
PowerShell(python -m pytest -q --ignore=tests/engine 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1; 1..3 | ForEach-Object { python -m pytest -q tests/engine 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1 })

PowerShell(git fetch origin --quiet; git status --short; "--- vs origin/dev: ahead {0}, behind {1}" -f \(git rev-list --count origin/dev..HEAD\), \(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/dev\); "--- new on dev since we branched:"; git log --oneline HEAD..origin/dev; "--- vs own remote:"; git status -sb | Select-Object -First 1)

PowerShell(Get-Content tokenization_ai\\dashboard_static\\page-policy.js -Raw | node --input-type=module --check; "node check exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; python -m pytest -q tests/tokenization_ai/test_dashboard.py tests/tokenization_ai/test_dashboard_phase2.py tests/tokenization_ai/test_dashboard_phase3.py tests/tokenization_ai/test_dashboard_phase4.py tests/tokenization_ai/test_dashboard_final_qa.py 2>&1 | Select-String "FAILED|passed|error" | Select-Object -Last 8)

PowerShell(foreach \($p in 8002, 8010\) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; "port {0}: {1}" -f $p, $\(if \($c\) { "PID $\($c.OwningProcess\) " + \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $\($c.OwningProcess\)"\).CreationDate } else { "free" }\) }; Select-String -Path tokenization_ai\\dashboard.py -Pattern "read_bytes|read_text|lru_cache|_ASSETS" | Select-Object -First 5)
